weighting: equal domain means; Banglish variants remain within the same domain block
uncertainty: paired crossed resampling of three training seeds and six domain blocks; excludes annotation uncertainty
selection_rule: promote longer original only if every gate passes in both budgets; otherwise retain unchanged
test_rule: freeze development decision before any fresh reserved-test scoring; test confirms or rejects, never tunes the choice
causal_limit: longer exposure, English retention and hard negatives change together; this is not an isolated ablation
